chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Barqī, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from Abū Jamīlah, from Zurārah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

ʿAlī عليه السلام was brought a man who had manipulated his private part until he ejaculated, so he struck his hand with a whip until it became red. And I only know that he said: and he married him from the treasury of the Muslims.

key_terms.بَيْتِ مَالِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the public treasury of the Muslims
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī, peace be upon him, the authority issuing the judgment

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule for a man who masturbated?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal judgment of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning a man who committed masturbation. It indicates a disciplinary punishment and mentions facilitating his marriage from the public treasury, reflecting both penal correction and social remedy.
